purpose: Contexto regional de anomalías de almacenamiento de agua y sequía.

source_attributes.geospatial_lat_resolution: 0.25 degree grid; however the mascons are estimated on a 1-degree equal area mascons and the native resolution of the GRACE/GRACE-FO data is roughly 300km
source_attributes.label: RL0603rc24cE
source_attributes.user_note_1: The accelerometer on the GRACE-B spacecraft was turned off after August 2016.  After this date, the accelerometer on GRACE-A was used to derive the non-gravitational accelerations acting on GRACE-B using a transplant procedure.  This has led to a subsequent degradation in the quality of the gravity fields derived.
source_attributes.user_note_2: The accelerometer on the GRACE-FO 2 spacecraft has underperformed since after launch.  The accelerometer on GRACE-FO 1 was used to derive the non-gravitational accelerations acting on GRACE-FO 2 using a transplant procedure. This has led to a degradation in the quality of the gravity fields derived.
